title.narrative: Preventing and Responding to Violent Extremism (PVE) in the Atlantic Corridor

description.narrative: To prevent and address the immediate localized drivers of radicalization leading to violent extremism in target communities in Benin, Cote d’Ivoire, Ghana and Togo, while providing support to strengthening the ‘Infrastructures for Peace’, namely mechanisms for early warning, and early response at local-level.
